name: mcp-nychousing
description: Read NYC Open Data for one building or one landlord: HPD violations, complaints, registration and litigation, DOB records, 311 heat complaints, marshal evictions, and ownership two ways (HPD registration and the property record).
long_description: A read-only MCP server over NYC Open Data (Socrata/SODA) for tenant organizers, housing-court legal-aid intake, and Right-to-Counsel orgs. Ten tools cover a building's condition, its registered owner and agent, the recorded deed behind them, the rest of that landlord's portfolio, and the building's court and eviction history. No account and no key are required; an optional Socrata app token only raises the per-IP rate limit.

app_token.title: Socrata app token (optional)
app_token.description: Leave blank unless you hit rate limits. NYC Open Data is keyless; a free app token from dev.socrata.com only raises the per-IP limit. Every tool works without one.
